newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Coutts to market funds in Austria.
newsitem.headline: Coutts to market funds in Austria.

text.p: Coutts Group, the global private banking arm of Britain's National Westminster Group and bankers to the royal family, said on Wednesday it would strive to sell 17 of its funds in Austria.

"We have registered 17 of our funds in Austria and we expect them to find good response in the market," Pierre Stonborough, executive vice president of the Austrian branch of Coutts, told a news conference.
Coutts, which specialises in private asset management, would use the bank's existing networks to sell their funds, Stonborough said.
Coutts offers a total of 23 mutual funds with a capitalisation of 784 million sterling. -- Christian Gutlederer, Vienna Newsroom, +43 1 531 12 275
